## Main manuscript figures

```{r}
# Generate operating-characteristic summaries for the rule-based and Bayesian CRM dose-finding designs
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(kableExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(truncnorm)

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Load help functions to create figures
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
source(here::here("fig_tables", "R", "fig_helpers.R"))
```



### Figure 1 - Conceptual illustration of a monotonic dose-response relationship used in dose-finding studies
```{r}
# Create dose grid
dose <- seq(0, 10, length.out = 200)

# Target levels
TTL <- 0.25
target_inf <- 0.70

fig1 <- create_fig_concept(dose, TTL, target_inf)
fig1

ggsave(here::here("fig_tables", "save_plots","concept_fig.eps"), width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```



### Figure 2 - Example dose-response curves under several commonly used models
```{r}
fig2 <- create_fig_ds_curves()
fig2

ggsave(here::here("fig_tables", "save_plots","dif_drmodels_fig.eps"), width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```





### Figure 3 - Illustration of posterior updating and adaptive dose allocation in the Bayesian CRM
```{r}
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# User settings
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Select prior: "id70_p" or "ab_p"; id70_p = Prior on a and log10(ID70); ab_p = Prior on a and b
prior_spec <- "id70_p"


cap_method <- "capped"


example_scenario <- 4
example_sim <- 45


# Prior distribution settings for a and log10(ID70)
# id70_p
# log(a) ~ Uniform(log(a_lower), log(a_upper))
# log10(ID70) ~ Normal(log10_id70_mean, log10_id70_sd^2),
# truncated to (log10_id70_lower, log10_id70_upper)

id70_settings <- list(
  a_lower = 0.3,
  a_upper = 0.8,
  log10_id70_mean = 4,
  log10_id70_sd = 0.8,
  log10_id70_lower = 3,
  log10_id70_upper = 7
)


# Distribution settings for a and b
# ab_p
# log(a) ~ Uniform(log(a_lower), log(a_upper))
# log(b) ~ Uniform(log(b_lower), log(b_upper))

ab_settings <- list(
  a_lower = 0.1,
  a_upper = 0.7,
  b_lower = 20,
  b_upper = 600
)


example_output_folder <- here::here(
  "bayesian_crm",
  "results",
  "examples",
  paste0(
    "scenario_",
    example_scenario,
    "_sim_",
    example_sim,
    "_",
    prior_spec,
    "_",
    cap_method
  )
)

trial_dat <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(
    example_output_folder,
    "learning_trial_dat.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

post_curves <- readr::read_csv(
  file.path(
    example_output_folder,
    "learning_post_curves.csv"
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

scenarios <- readr::read_csv(
  here::here(
    "data",
    paste0(
      "pars_scenarios_",
      prior_spec,
      ".csv"
    )
  ),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)

posterior_updating_plot <- create_fig_posterior_updating(
    trial_dat          = trial_dat,
    post_curves        = post_curves,
    true_a             = scenarios$a[example_scenario],
    true_b             = scenarios$b[example_scenario],
    id70_settings      = id70_settings,
    target_prob        = 0.70,
    n_cohorts_to_plot  = 5
  )

posterior_updating_plot
```






















### Figure 4 - Distribution of trial sizes under the rule-based and Bayesian CRM designs (uncapped and capped) across 1000 prior predictive simulations
```{r}
#-----------------------------
# Load capped + uncapped results
#-----------------------------
rule_cap   <- read_rulebased_sizes("id70_p", "random", "capped")
rule_uncap <- read_rulebased_sizes("id70_p", "random", "uncapped")

crm_cap    <- read_crm_sizes("id70_p", "random", "capped")
crm_uncap  <- read_crm_sizes("id70_p", "random", "uncapped")


fig4 <- create_fig_trial_size_random(rule_cap, rule_uncap, crm_cap, crm_uncap)
fig4

ggsave(here::here("fig_tables", "save_plots","trial_sizes_both_id70p.eps"), width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

  log10_id70_upper = 7

### Figure 6 - Distribution of total study sizes across the five scenarios for the capped 5+5+10 rule-based design and capped Bayesian CRM
```{r}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# User settings
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Select: "capped" or "uncapped"
cap_method <- "capped"

# Select: "random" or "scenarios"
generation_method <- "scenarios"

# Select prior: "id70_p" or "ab_p"; id70_p = Prior on a and log10(ID70); ab_p = Prior on a and b
prior_spec <- "id70_p"


# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read simulation results
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Rule-based results
sims_file <- here::here(
    "rule_based",
    "results",
    paste0(
      "rb_",
      prior_spec,
      "_",
      generation_method,
      "_",
      cap_method,
      ".csv"
    )
  )
  
rule_sims <- readr::read_csv(
  sims_file, 
  col_names = c("dose","infected","total","scenario","design","sim","kk"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# Bayesian CRM results
results_folder <- here::here(
  "bayesian_crm",
  "results",
  paste0(
    "bcrm_",
    prior_spec,
    "_",
    generation_method,
    "_",
    cap_method
  )
)
  
sims_file = file.path(
  results_folder,
  "sims.csv"
)
  
crm_sims <- readr::read_csv(
  sims_file, 
  col_names = c("dose", "infected", "total", "scenario", "design", "sim", "kk"), 
  show_col_types = FALSE
)
  
fig6 <- create_fig_trial_size_5scn(rule_sims, crm_sims)
fig6


ggsave(here::here("fig_tables", "save_plots","trial_sizes_both_5s_id70p.eps"), width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

### Figure 3 - Estimated ID70 values obtained under the capped Bayesian CRM for each of the 1000 simulations per scenario (Prior on ID70 and a)

```{r}

# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# User settings
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Select: "capped" or "uncapped"
cap_method <- "capped"

# Select: "random" or "scenarios"
generation_method <- "scenarios"

# Select prior: "id70_p" or "ab_p"; id70_p = Prior on a and log10(ID70); ab_p = Prior on a and b
prior_spec <- "id70_p"



# -------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Read simulation results
# -------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Bayesian results
results_folder <- here::here(
  "bayesian_crm",
  "results",
  paste0(
    "bcrm_",
    prior_spec,
    "_",
    generation_method,
    "_",
    cap_method
  )
)
  
id70_file = file.path(
  results_folder,
  "est.id70s.csv"
)
  
id70 <- readr::read_csv(
  id70_file, 
  col_names = c("q05","q25","q50","q75","q95","sim","n.doses","design","scenario","rn"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


# True scenario data
pars_file <- here::here(
    "data",
    paste0(
      "pars_scenarios_",
      prior_spec,
      ".csv"
    )
  )


# Rule-based results
sims_file <- here::here(
    "rule_based",
    "results",
    paste0(
      "rb_",
      prior_spec,
      "_",
      generation_method,
      "_",
      cap_method,
      ".csv"
    )
  )
  
rule_sims <- readr::read_csv(
  sims_file
  )



fig3_append <- create_fig_estid70(prior_spec, generation_method, cap_method, id70, pars_file, rule_sims) 
fig3_append

ggsave(here::here("fig_tables", "save_plots","estid70_5s_id70p_n1000.png"), width = 8, height = 9, dpi = 300)
```

### Figure 7 - Distribution of total study sizes across the five scenarios for the capped 5+5+10 rule-based design and capped Bayesian CRM
